source_text: Venerunt in Elim: duodecim fontes, septuaginta palmae. Apostoli fontes; septuaginta discipuli. Post amaritudinem refrigerium ecclesiae.
pass_a_gloss: They-came into Elim: twelve springs, seventy palms. Apostles springs; seventy disciples. After bitterness refreshment of-church.
pass_b_english: They came to [[Elim: twelve springs and seventy palm trees >> Bible:Exodus 15:27]]. The springs figure the apostles; the palms the seventy. After bitterness, the church’s refreshment.
